decision: E2 continuous world EE-only task curriculum, starting from E1 candidate100
reason: Both engines improve every workspace position case and all test8 position checks complete/pass; orientation is mixed and persistent raised feet remain in both arms. This supports learning a fixed task curriculum, not accepting WBC or attributing support failure to one reward coefficient. No further reward-weight scan is selected.
initialization_semantics: One initialize-from transfer: restore Actor/Critic/normalizers/fixed std, fresh Adam1e-5 and fresh UMI EMA widths; new reference RNG and simulator episodes. Subsequent same-config extension uses --resume with optimizer/EMA/sampler/RNG restored and simulator episodes restarted.
review: Inspect actual per-group transitions, errors, fall/timeout durations and reward means during learning; representative immutable checkpoint MuJoCo readouts around250/500 and both-engine development evaluation at1000. Stage reviews are not permission gates or formal acceptance.
stop: NaN, invalid input/coordinates, simulator invalidity or resource conflict immediately. Persistent severe loss of task duration/support across several checkpoints can stop at the next full PPO update with --stop-file. A single noisy training window or one worse case is not a stop rule. After1000 choose continuation toward2000/4000 or change hypothesis using actual task/contact evidence; do not promise10000/20000.
risk: High Gaussian KL in existing low fixed-std recipe: per-update minibatch mean of action-dimension-summed KL, LR already at1e-5 floor; not an identified logging bug or a claim that KL is controlled.
evidence_limit: All provisional parameters; trained=false; world TCP position+orientation targets only, single18-joint Actor, no base velocity/pose/gait commands. Curriculum names do not establish learned body/step capability. Train10 readouts are not held-out validation. Orientation formal threshold unspecified.
